803-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4365-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4275-5003-5147-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-5147-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

849-1263-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

524-1167-7735.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4068-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

2034-5170-6132-6559.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

625-1606-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Ley Weaver using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

1796-2342-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4659-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-6719.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1987-3227-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Scrivener.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1251-1270-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

851-1563-1753-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1916-2773-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Changeling Titan.
1916-2773-3362.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {3}{R}.
When Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, it and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Changeling Titan trigger, exiling Bladewing until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage to Changeling Titan equal to Changeling Titan's power.
Changeling Titan dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
When Changeling Titan dies, it triggers, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage equal to Bladewing's power to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning Changeling Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

509-662-1267-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-662-1267-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

3140-3174-6085.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying {4}{U}, exchanging control of Altanak and another creature with an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3946-4426-5451.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

678-3621-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Repeat.

2763-3774.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least four loyalty counters.
Luxior attached to Kaya.
2763-3774.description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Kaya and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Kaya token.

413-4605-4681-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Preston and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Preston trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Karmic Guide token's trigger, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

229-1806-2232-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
229-1806-2232-3771.description:
Cast Endless One, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Endless One enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Eternal Scourge from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Eternal Scourge by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1295-2135-2503.description:
Activate Elixir of Immortality by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain five life and shuffle Elixir of Immortality and your graveyard into your library.
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, exiling your library face down.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

2034-2577-3263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1052-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2525-3413-4283-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2525-3413-4283-5295.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing itself and any other creature you control, targeting Body Double.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Whisper ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Whisper.
Activate Body Double by tapping it, sacrificing itself and the Zombie token, targeting Whisper.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Whisper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
